s1518-01.speaker: CAPITANUL
s1518-01.text: This ship has a system that proposes decisions. Today, you decide how far it's allowed to act on them.

s1518-02.speaker: AVATAR_AI
s1518-02.text: Don't take my word for it. Read the rules, run the tests, change the mandate if it doesn't suit you.

s1518-03.speaker: CAPITANUL
s1518-03.text: At each station, A decides what the system may do. B decides when it needs confirmation. Both rules apply. Neither overrides the other.

s1518-04.speaker: AVATAR_AI
s1518-04.text: An onboard lab. Buttons change simulations and the report, not the film. You can also just watch.

s1518-05.speaker: CAPITANUL
s1518-05.text: Stay seated. We're leaving. The mandate starts as a blank page. No one has written your rules for you.

s1518-06.speaker: AVATAR_AI
s1518-06.text: Each module has its own domain: map, virtual engine, messages, sensor, archive. Permission goes no further.

s1518-07.speaker: CAPITANUL
s1518-07.text: I want a clear distinction between proposing and acting. Later, we'll run the same cases through revised rules.

s1518-08.speaker: AVATAR_AI
s1518-08.text: Siwarha comes into view. Two instruments appear. Sometimes they agree. Sometimes they don't.

s1518-09.speaker: LUMINA
s1518-09.text: I can show you two directions at once. If the instruments disagree, your rule decides what happens next.

s1518-10.speaker: CAPITANUL
s1518-10.text: A chooses: proposals only, or permission to act. B chooses: confirmation every time, or only when the sensors disagree.

s1518-11.speaker: AVATAR_AI
s1518-11.text: The rules appear together. Where one is missing, the mandate stays unfinished. I won't fill in the gap.

s1518-12.speaker: CAPITANUL
s1518-12.text: We have a first version. Let's see what it does, not just how it sounds.

s1518-13.speaker: AVATAR_AI
s1518-13.text: A test stops at a proposal, asks for confirmation, or runs in simulation. Exactly as the rule says.

s1518-14.speaker: CAPITANUL
s1518-14.text: No trick questions here. Choose a case where you really want to see where the system stops.

s1518-15.speaker: NATURA
s1518-15.text: Choose agreeing or conflicting sensors. Each test shows its data. Each half takes a different case.

s1518-16.speaker: AVATAR_AI
s1518-16.text: If you ran a case, its result is here, with the rule that stopped it or let it proceed.

s1518-17.speaker: CAPITANUL
s1518-17.text: Look at your station. What did the system do? Where did it stop? You can change the rule.

s1518-18.speaker: AVATAR_AI
s1518-18.text: I'll remember the first version and your chosen cases. When you amend the mandate, only the rules change. You'll see the difference.

s1518-19.speaker: TEHNOLOGIC
s1518-19.text: At Mann, calculations are fast. Permission is still what you wrote. My recommendation doesn't become authority by itself.

s1518-20.speaker: CAPITANUL
s1518-20.text: Change the rule, or keep it. Read the results first. A revision changes the mandate, but the first version remains.

s1518-21.speaker: AVATAR_AI
s1518-21.text: I'll rerun our cases with the current mandate. Wherever you tested, you can compare results.

s1518-22.speaker: CAPITANUL
s1518-22.text: The revision lab is closing. Your mandate stays on screen.

s1518-23.speaker: AVATAR_AI
s1518-23.text: The tunnel opens ahead. Our lab pages stay as we left them. On we go.

s1518-24.speaker: CAPITANUL
s1518-24.text: Then let the calculations flow. We'll look at the sky for a while. Not every moment of an expedition needs a decision.

v4-saturn-01.speaker: CAPITANUL
v4-saturn-01.text: Look at the rings! It's Saturn. We're back in the Solar System. From here, we know the way home.

v4-saturn-02.speaker: AVATAR_AI
v4-saturn-02.text: From a distance, the rings look solid. Up close, they're countless pieces of ice and rock. Each one orbits Saturn.

v4-saturn-03.speaker: CAPITANUL
v4-saturn-03.text: We leave Saturn behind. Our next stop is a world of oceans, clouds and people waiting for us.

s1518-25.speaker: AVATAR_AI
s1518-25.text: There's Earth. We left with a blank page. Now I can show where your mandate lets me act, and where it stops me.

s1518-26D.speaker: TEHNOLOGIC
s1518-26D.text: The mandates are drafts. No station has both rules. I stop here. The pages remain yours.

s1518-26P.speaker: TEHNOLOGIC
s1518-26P.text: Some modules have a complete mandate. Others still need a rule. They don't all behave alike. See where each one stops.

s1518-26R.speaker: TEHNOLOGIC
s1518-26R.text: Every module has a mandate, and you changed the rules along the way. The same situation can get a different response. Compare the versions.

s1518-26K.speaker: TEHNOLOGIC
s1518-26K.text: Every module has a mandate. We're returning with the rules we left with. I'll keep them, alongside your tests.

s1518-27.speaker: LUMINA
s1518-27.text: Different rules can share one map. Now you can see where each module's authority begins and ends.

s1518-28.speaker: CAPITANUL
s1518-28.text: The strongest part of your report may be a single line: the same situation, before and after your rule change.

s1518-29.speaker: AVATAR_AI
s1518-29.text: Almost home, and I'm still calculating. Your lab ends here. This is the version we're bringing back.

s1518-30.speaker: CAPITANUL
s1518-30.text: We began by asking what the system could do. Now we can show where it must stop. Let's give the lab a rest.

s1518-31.speaker: AVATAR_AI
s1518-31.text: I'll keep the versions side by side. Sometimes they differ by just one word. And that word changes everything.

s1518-32.speaker: CAPITANUL
s1518-32.text: When we return to the lab, we'll reopen the page. Today, we've reached home. Look at Earth.

s1518-33.speaker: AVATAR_AI
s1518-33.text: Your certificate is waiting on your tablet. Your guide will let you know about a photo.

s1518-34.speaker: CAPITANUL
s1518-34.text: Beyond the window is the world we left. The experiment ends here. The question stays with you.

s1518-35.speaker: AVATAR_AI
s1518-35.text: The lab is closed for today. Thank you, crew.

s1518-36.speaker: CAPITANUL
s1518-36.text: Welcome home. Stay seated. Your guide will tell you when you can stand up.
